question: If the ratio of the volume of two spheres is 1 : 8, then the ratio of their surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volumes** (V₁ : V₂) = 1 : 8

Ratio of **Radii** (r₁ : r₂) = ³√1 : ³√8 = 1 : 2

Ratio of **Surface Areas** (A₁ : A₂) = (r₁)² : (r₂)² = 1² : 2² = 1 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of **Volumes** of two spheres = 1 : 8

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³ | Surface Area of sphere = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a85f56475244e4525ee818dbd98dc626e1f5f66ef6405fd603ffdb4fc76018b8.png] 

⇒ V₁ / V₂ = [(4/3)πr₁³] / [(4/3)πr₂³] = 1 / 8

⇒ (r₁ / r₂)³ = 1 / 8

⇒ r₁ / r₂ = ³√(1 / 8) = 1 / 2

⇒ Ratio of Surface Areas = (4πr₁²) / (4πr₂²)

⇒ Ratio of Surface Areas = (r₁ / r₂)² = (1 / 2)² = 1 / 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dimensional Proportionality

For any similar 3D shapes, if the ratio of **linear dimensions** (radius, side) is a:b, then the ratio of **surface areas** is a²:b² and the ratio of **volumes** is a³:b³.

Hemisphere Formulas

For a **hemisphere** of radius r, the Curved Surface Area (CSA) is 2πr², the Total Surface Area (TSA) is 3πr², and the Volume is (2/3)πr³.</p
